reason: As a tech-forward practitioner eager to automate client intake and eliminate the two hours I waste every Saturday reconciling pending GST filings, the pre-loaded statutory blueprints directly address my fear of wasting time training rotating article clerks. At ₹21,990 a year for the Growth Tier, the ready-to-use GST queues and WhatsApp bridge make it an easy investment to streamline our 6 to 20 person practice.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years, and my biggest worry is whether they will actually adopt and follow the pre-made blueprints without requiring constant oversight and training from me.
